description:
Offline, encrypted personal finance manager (Brazilian Portuguese)

Finan+ is a simple, lightweight and private personal finance app. It works fully offline: your data stays on your device, with no account and no external server.

Note: the app interface is in Brazilian Portuguese and amounts are in Brazilian reais (R$).

Features

  • Income and expenses with categories, accounts and credit cards (current bill and bill payment)
  • Installments, recurring transactions, bills to pay and to receive
  • Current balance and projected end-of-month balance, plus a calendar with each day's balance
  • Monthly limits per category and savings goals: saving into a goal takes the money out of the account without counting it as an expense
  • "What if…?" simulator to save, plan a purchase or pay off a debt early, without touching your data
  • Read a bill or boleto: amount and due date from a PDF (password-protected too), the boleto line or a Pix code
  • Reports with charts and PDF report export
  • On-device assistant: suggests categories from descriptions, summarizes the month, gives saving tips and answers quick questions, always explaining why
  • Balance widget and daily due-date reminders
  • 7 themes, including Gruvbox, OLED, Tokyo Night and Nord
  • Network access (optional): use Finan+ in your computer's browser on the same Wi-Fi, with the data staying on the phone. HTTPS with the phone's own certificate, a code and confirmation on the phone
  • JSON backup and restore (compatible with Finan+ web and Finan+ for Linux) and CSV export
  • Automatic backup: one copy a day, encrypted with a password, to a folder you choose (phone, SD card, Google Drive, Nextcloud…)

Privacy and security

  • Data encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key kept in the Android Keystore
  • PIN and/or strong biometric lock, with auto-lock
  • Screenshots blocked by default and an option to hide amounts
  • Discreet notifications and widget when the app is protected
  • No ads, no trackers, no account, no sign-up
  • The network permission is only for local network access: off until you turn it on, works only on your home Wi-Fi and turns itself off after 10 minutes of inactivity. The app never connects to the internet

Finan+ is free software, licensed under the GNU GPL v3 or later.
